title: Gluing of concrete open module direct-image units
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U,V$ be open subsets with $U\cup V=X$, and let $M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $A$, write $M_A=j_{A*}r_A M$, $\eta_A:M\to M_A$ for the transported restriction/direct-image unit, and $\rho_{A,W}:M_A\to M_W$ for the canonical nested-open restriction of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data]. Then the square with arrows $\eta_U$, $\eta_V$, $\rho_{U,U\cap V}$, and $\rho_{V,U\cap V}$ is a pullback in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. No injectivity hypothesis is imposed on $M$.

proof.text: The two composites equal the unit to U intersection V by schemeOpenModuleImage_unit_restriction.

For every pullback cone, choose an amalgamation from the existence theorem. Its two equations give the cone factorization identities. The uniqueness theorem makes this choice uniquely determined and proves the final universal-property clause. Apply PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk and IsPullback.of_isLimit'.

from.place: Derived Mayer-Vietoris gluing over two opens: sheaf gluing gives the kernel of the degreewise restriction/difference sequence

lean.statement:
theorem schemeOpenModuleImage_isPullback
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    IsPullback ((schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X U).unit.app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X V).unit.app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M)
